notes.content:
It always seemed to me that the throne room was not interesting enough building. Increasing discontent is a useful thing, but a revolution may not always be the goal. As a result, I added royal decrees, a list of decrees opens when the throne room is built.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460815/9221154a60e75814398260449c5e5ef10cb0486e.png[/img]

Royal decrees are not very numerous yet. However, I think to add more decrees later - I need to understand what bonuses are missing in the game, at the moment when players open the throne room - on this basis, new decrees can be added.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460815/aa153b2aff4c920b551f27692e638ea28bccc1a3.png[/img]

notes.title: Warlocks added
notes.content:
New race, warlocks, has been added to the game! Like other races, Warlocks give 2 new buildings.

[b]Sealed boxes (paired with city walls)[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460815/35c8033b5469f2a31340c9f6b375c447acf58d23.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460815/29c7ad3826d08786106fa6a147a436e8eaa28e31.png[/img]
Dark Tower gives +50 to max mana and opens a new spell: the curse.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460815/5d6ca7f154b3cbf91247ab580ec84132deab5b79.png[/img]

[h1]Warlock skills[/h1]
Except for buildings, assimilation of warlocks will open warlock skills and warlock goods.

[h1]Future plans[/h1]
I have accumulated a lot of comments about the interface of the game, and in the next update I'm thinking of improving it a bit :)

notes.title: Formula for calculating the B.P. of swordsmen changed. (+ Bugfixes.)
notes.content:
The formula for calculating the Battle Power of swordsmen and archers has been changed. Now perseverance clearly acts on the bonus from garrisons (and from the palisades).

New formula:
Swordsman Battle Power = (1 + <castles> + <garrison bonus>)*<perseverance %>
Archer Battle Power = (1 + <elf bonus> + <palisade bonus>)*<perseverance %>
Previously, perseverance did not affect bonus from garrisons. Now, as I hope, garrisons and palisades will be more valuable. 


[h1]Bugfixes (Nomads, Butcher's tent, Wagon)[/h1]
I recently fixed a bug in the game: together with assimilation of the elves you could get a hidden assimilation of the nomads. In fact, nomads can only be opened after 5 assimilations of elves. The nomads open the butcher's tent and the wagon. After the hidden nomads assimilation bugfix, these buildings could dissappear (if you built them). I apologize for that.

I hope that all nomads bugs has been fixed and I can continue to work on assimilation bonuses.

notes.title: City wall bonus | Garrisons improved
notes.content:
City walls bonus has been changed. If you have at least 2 city walls, swordsmen will recieve additional battle power from garrisons.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460815/683c4124c9517b357d58d5213ca25c0545619a1c.png[/img]
The previous mechanics were not good because it forced you to delay the construction of city walls, so that they did not increase the cost of the garrison. The new mechanic of the city walls is not bound by the cost of the garrisons, you can build walls and garrisons in any order. Moreover, now garrisons can be useful to you, even if you are not going to do swordsmen revolution.

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
- imported save did’n load animals in rare cases
- negative food value issue fixed
- 0 gold glitch when buying a lot of units fixed

[h1]Plains - work in progress[/h1]
Currently I'm working on a new location "Plains".
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460815/8f69c2ecf18b95e66406bfb6a7903c4ea2644ae9.png[/img]
I hope to finish it over the weekend.

notes.title: The first amnesty of bugs

notes.title: Big numbers math - an important update that may be unnoticed
notes.content:
As it turned out, the maximum possible number in the game is about 10^300. At higher values the game stops working. This can not be called a game engine problem (the game is made in Game Maker Studio) because 10^300 is a very very large number. However, Realm Revolutions is an incremental game and sooner or later super-large numbers may appear in it.

In this update (v0.16), all operations with numbers has been rewritten, and now the numbers can be as large as possible.

Such update does not add new content, but with this update it will be possible to add new things to the game, without fear that later we will reach the limit of gold or food. So I think this update is quite important and that work had to be done before adding new content.
